name: IGNIX VPN MAX

catalog.method: SCKIT VMP transport; X-IGNIX-SIG = SHA-1 of signer cert, X-IGNIX-AUTH = server_token; catalog cipher unidentified (lives in VMP bytecode)
catalog.notes: Challenge 200 with nonce; catalog without token -> 401 no autorizado; without signature -> 403 firma invalida. Registration could not be completed (20+ variants -> 400). decode() returns CIPHER_PENDING for non-JSON bodies.

filesNote: No importable proprietary format; _archivos.py reads the decrypted Config.json / ConfigPremium.json the app saves in filesDir.
